symptom: `alter page … set (Caption: …) on Qty` against a DataGrid 2 inside an **Accordion group** reports `widget "Qty" not found … available columns: Name, Qty`, and the qualified `on g1.Qty` reports `widget "g1" not found` — the grid and everything else in the group are unaddressable while the error advertises its columns
cause: `findInWidgetChildren` descended into a pluggable widget's own `Object.Properties[].Value.Widgets` and into the `columns` object list (#834), but not into any OTHER object list — Accordion groups and Pop-up menu items keep their widgets at `Value.Objects[].Properties[].Value.Widgets`. The not-found message comes from `collectColumnNamesBson`, a generic walk of the whole tree, so it saw what the resolver could not. `collectWidgetScopeInChildren` had the same gap; `findNearestDSInChildren` had already been given the descent for #935
insight: Four walkers traverse the same page tree (`findInWidgetChildren`, `collectWidgetScopeInChildren`, `findNearestDSInChildren`, the generic `collectColumnNamesBson`) and each was patched per container, so they disagree: when an error message lists a name the resolver just refused, diff the walker that BUILT THE MESSAGE against the one that resolved — the message is a free oracle for what the resolver should reach. Key the descent on the BSON shape (`Objects[].Properties[].Value.Widgets`), not on a property key like `groups`, so Pop-up menu items are covered too; skip `columns` there so a column's derived name still wins over a same-named widget in its customContent cell. Unit fixture trap: a column type with no `ValueType.Type` makes the caption setter fall to `PrimitiveValue` and `DSet`-append onto a copied `bson.D`, so the write may or may not be visible depending on slice capacity — declare `header` as `TextTemplate`, as the shipped widget does. Control: the unfixed binary refuses with the reporter's exact message; fixed, `mx check` (11.12.1) 0 errors. Repro `mdl-examples/bug-tests/891-alter-page-grid-inside-accordion-group.mdl`. Issue #891 (ako/mxcli#1274)
